text:
sara: heads-up — opened PR to tidy microcopy & naming in SDK examples. small surface: function name consistency, casing (snake_case vs camelCase), and short tone adjustments for param docs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :eyes:

matt: thanks! quick skim — examples look good. one suggestion: use `client.generate()` rather than `client.create()` to match runtime names. also remove 'simply' from the first paragraph (tone). :thumbsup:

jie: +1 on `generate()` rename. note for the async snippet — we prefer the context manager pattern for connection lifecycle:

```
async with Client(api_key=KEY) as client:
  resp = await client.generate(prompt)
```

current snippet uses `await client.connect()` then `await client.close()` which we don't want to encourage. I'll push a tiny commit to the PR.

olivia: found a couple of link issues in migration guide (line ~130): the anchor `#model-compat` 404s in the new nav. PR also moved some headings. Suggest we add a short redirection note and fix the link target. I can open a follow-up PR or include it here if it's small.

sara: thanks both. pls include your commits in PR #4123 if small. olivia — if you want to add the redirect, go ahead and tag me in the PR for review.

matt: tiny editorial thing — glossary uses "model variant" and "variant" interchangeably. can we standardize to "model variant" everywhere? I'll grep and list hits if useful.

jie: I can run a quick search/replace in examples. but for the glossary we should add a canonical entry: `model variant` -> "A specific compiled/quantized version of a model used for serving." I'll draft wording.

sara: agree on canonical term. also let's add a short note in docs style guide: prefer noun-first definitions (e.g., "Model variant: <def>") and avoid starting with "A" where possible in gloss entries. keeps format compact.

docs-bot: deploy-preview published: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.ai — checks: linkscan passed, lint: 1 warning (line 42: trailing-space), build: success.

olivia: preview looks good. I left an inline comment about preserving example output formatting (triple backticks). Otherwise LGTM.

matt: re: tone — can we add a one-line note in the SDK samples about error messages returning structured objects vs strings? A few customers parsed text and broke. Keep it short: "Use structured error fields (code/message) not ad-hoc parsing of message text."

jie: added that note in examples and updated the snippet to check `resp.error.code` first. Pushed.

sara: awesome. final checklist before merge: 1) rename generate in code samples (done), 2) glossary entry draft (jie), 3) migration link redirect (olivia or separate PR), 4) fix lint warning (I'll tidy). If nobody objects, I'll merge after fixes and run the patch release.

matt: no objections from me.

olivia: fine with merge after redirect is opened — can be follow-up.

jie: ready.

sara: merging in ~30m unless someone flags. tagging @eng-runtime for awareness about the `generate()` naming change.
__notes: This thread captures a short docs coordination exchange: small SDK examples PR, naming/tone decisions, glossary canonicalization, migration link fix, and deploy preview. Messages intentionally short and Slacky.
